parameters.query: select l.* from leads l join campaign_config c on c.account_id = l.account_id where l.state in ('queued','accepted','in_followup') and (l.next_run_at is null or l.next_run_at <= now()) and (c.next_send_at is null or c.next_send_at <= now()) order by l.next_run_at nulls first limit 1;
select coalesce(invites,0) as invites, coalesce(messages,0) as messages from counters where account_id = $1 and day = current_date;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-4-8', max_tokens: 400, system: $json.voice, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Write this LinkedIn ' + ($json.isInvite ? 'invite note (max 300 chars)' : 'message (50-120 words)') + '.\nTASK: ' + $json.promptOrText + '\nPROSPECT: ' + $json.lead.full_name + ' — ' + ($json.lead.title||'') + ' at ' + ($json.lead.company||'') + '. No emojis, no pitch, one question.' } ] }) }}

parameters.query: insert into counters (account_id, day, invites, messages) values ($1, current_date, $2, $3) on conflict (account_id, day) do update set invites = counters.invites + excluded.invites, messages = counters.messages + excluded.messages;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.account_id }},{{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.isInvite ? 1 : 0 }},{{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.isInvite ? 0 : 1 }}

parameters.query: update leads set step = step + 1, state = case when $2 = 'true' then 'awaiting_accept' when $3 = 'true' then 'in_followup' else 'completed' end, next_run_at = case when $2 = 'true' then null when $3 = 'true' then now() + ($4 || ' hours')::interval else null end, updated_at = now() where id = $1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.lead.id }},{{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.isInvite }},{{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.hasNext }},{{ $('Resolve step + cap gate').first().json.nextDelayHours || 24 }}

parameters.query: update campaign_config set next_send_at = now() + ($1 || ' seconds')::interval where id = 1;
